name: Meadow Books
description: A sky-and-meadow landing page for AI accounting software: a live bookkeeping dashboard in the hero, value props, a tabbed feature tour, how it works, a pinned full-screen video, case studies, testimonials, a traceable-ledger graph, pricing and a closing CTA — set in Inter.
designedFor: Accounting, bookkeeping and finance-automation SaaS landing pages
Products that read receipts and bank feeds with AI and show their working
Practices and fintechs who want a calm, trustworthy look rather than a spreadsheet one
Trying the editor's motion and action channels on a real marketing page
